100 def get_oauth_access_token(url, client_id, client_secret, token_type='jwt', grant_type='client_credentials',
101                            refresh_token=None,
102                            timeout=(REQUEST_CONNECT_TIMEOUT, REQUEST_READ_TIMEOUT)):
103     """
104     Retrieves OAuth 2.0 access token using the given grant type.
105 
106     Args:
107         url (str): Oauth2 access token endpoint, optionally including part of the path.
108         client_id (str): client ID
109         client_secret (str): client secret
110     Kwargs:
111         token_type (str): Type of token to return. Options include bearer and jwt.
112         grant_type (str): One of 'client_credentials' or 'refresh_token'
113         refresh_token (str): The previous access token (for grant_type=refresh_token)
114 
115     Raises:
116         requests.RequestException if there is a problem retrieving the access token.
117 
118     Returns:
119         tuple: Tuple containing (access token string, expiration datetime).
120 
121     """
122     now = datetime.datetime.utcnow()
123     data = {
124         'grant_type': grant_type,
125         'client_id': client_id,
126         'client_secret': client_secret,
127         'token_type': token_type,
128     }
129     if refresh_token:
130         data['refresh_token'] = refresh_token
131     else:
132         assert grant_type != 'refresh_token', "refresh_token parameter required"
133 
134     response = requests.post(
135         _get_oauth_url(url),
136         data=data,
137         headers={
138             'User-Agent': USER_AGENT,
139         },
140         timeout=timeout
141     )
142 
143     response.raise_for_status()  # Raise an exception for bad status codes.
144     try:
145         data = response.json()
146         access_token = data['access_token']
147         expires_in = data['expires_in']
148     except (KeyError, json.decoder.JSONDecodeError) as json_error:
149         raise requests.RequestException(response=response) from json_error
150 
151     expires_at = now + datetime.timedelta(seconds=expires_in)
152 
153     return access_token, expires_at

156 def get_and_cache_oauth_access_token(url, client_id, client_secret, token_type='jwt', grant_type='client_credentials',
157                                      refresh_token=None,
158                                      timeout=(REQUEST_CONNECT_TIMEOUT, REQUEST_READ_TIMEOUT)):
159     """
160     Retrieves a possibly cached OAuth 2.0 access token using the given grant type.
161 
162     See ``get_oauth_access_token`` for usage details.
163 
164     First retrieves the access token from the cache and ensures it has not expired. If
165     the access token either wasn't found in the cache, or was expired, retrieves a new
166     access token and caches it for the lifetime of the token.
167 
168     Note: Consider tokens to be expired ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRED_THRESHOLD_SECONDS early
169     to ensure the token won't expire while it is in use.
170 
171     Returns:
172         tuple: Tuple containing (access token string, expiration datetime).
173 
174     """
175     oauth_url = _get_oauth_url(url)
176     cache_key = 'edx_rest_api_client.access_token.{}.{}.{}.{}'.format(  # noqa: UP032
177         token_type,
178         grant_type,
179         client_id,
180         oauth_url,
181     )
182     cached_response = TieredCache.get_cached_response(cache_key)
183 
184     # Attempt to get an unexpired cached access token
185     if cached_response.is_found:
186         _, expiration = cached_response.value
187         # Double-check the token hasn't already expired as a safety net.
188         adjusted_expiration = expiration - datetime.timedelta(seconds=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRED_THRESHOLD_SECONDS)
189         if datetime.datetime.utcnow() < adjusted_expiration:
190             return cached_response.value
191 
192     # Get a new access token if no unexpired access token was found in the cache.
193     oauth_access_token_response = get_oauth_access_token(
194         oauth_url,
195         client_id,
196         client_secret,
197         grant_type=grant_type,
198         refresh_token=refresh_token,
199         timeout=timeout,
200     )
201 
202     # Cache the new access token with an expiration matching the lifetime of the token.
203     _, expiration = oauth_access_token_response
204     expires_in = (expiration - datetime.datetime.utcnow()).seconds - ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRED_THRESHOLD_SECONDS
205     TieredCache.set_all_tiers(cache_key, oauth_access_token_response, expires_in)
206 
207     return oauth_access_token_response
